anomalies.observed: The regulated +5V rail has no bypass capacitor in the netlist. The only capacitor, C1, is connected between VCC and GND on the regulator input side. The +5V net contains U1.2, U2.8, U3.8, R3.1, R7.1, J3.1, J4.2, and J6.2, but no capacitor.
anomalies.expected: An LM1117-5.0 linear regulator requires an output bypass capacitor on its VO/+5V rail for stability, and the MCU VCC pins should also be decoupled. Standard practice would place a capacitor from +5V to GND near the regulator/MCU supply.
